metadata.description: Name of the azd environment. Used to derive resource names and tags.

Agent access level. Low = read-only investigation, High = can take actions.
Agent action mode. Review = human approval, Automatic = agent acts independently.
Resource groups the agent is granted knowledge-graph access to. Defaults to the S1 resource group.
Name of the resource group to create.
Additional tags applied to every resource.
VNet-integrate the agent and deploy a Key Vault that only the agent subnet can reach. Free (service endpoint, no private endpoint).
Deploy Azure Front Door in front of the Container Apps environment. Only needed for S6; off by default for S1.
Azure region for the identity.
Stable token used to make resource names unique within the subscription.
Tags applied to the identity.

Tags applied to both resources.
Azure region for the environment.
Stable token used to make resource names unique within the subscription.
Tags applied to the environment.
